title: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 30% Cashback on Minimum $200.01 Spend, Capped at $100 Per Member @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 30% Cashback on Minimum $200.01 Spend, Capped at $100 Per Member @ TopCashback AU

[sunnyc] I want to see a $250 cap please. no point reducing cap
[docmartin] Cucked with the 100 cap. Narrow window lol
150+ cap ideal
[ATangk] Airpods 5 with wireless case will be $210 ish after cashback.
[Canberralad92] Is the cash back on single item or whole order? Couldn't see in the Tcb terms at a glance - Thanks :)
[Onapski] Would also love to know. Couple of Christmas prezzies sorted if so!
Can anyone confirm if we can order multiple items that still hit the +$200 min - Eg I could grab 2 of the Mario Kart World games for Switch 2 (one for our kiddos and one for the cousins)
Mario Kart link here: https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1123360163…
[sssx] The cashback and minimum spend is for the order, not individual items (assuming all are EM items, not WW items).
E.g. if I purchased 5 different switch games, say $41 each, that's $205 spend, I'd get $61.50 cashback tracked.
[Buz1986] That cap is killer. I would spend thousands if they removed the cap!
[Knightchampion] Anyone have anything worth getting from this deal?
[Knightchampion] Seems like this is worth getting when stacked with cashback: https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1126539113…
Comes down to $157.50 for samsung buds 3 pro when stacked with cashback.
[Dalryk] (8) Cashback is ineligible on use of gift cards, vouchers, or store credit for partial or full payment.
Ugh
[wackedupwacko] Small cap- theres been bigger caps in recent months from memory.
This basically means best value is around $350 AUD.
[syngen] If there’s a GET10 (on the page itself, get $10 off your Everyday Market order).
Would using that invalidate the Cashback?
[ImTofu] it will void the cashback
(2) Cashback is ineligible if using any Woolworths Rewards points or gift cards as payment. Cashback is also ineligible if applying any coupon codes or vouchers
[ImTofu] Got an Airpods Pro 3 for my wife last time (same deal - 30% cap $100).
Someone last time worked out the maths that the price has to be between $200-$330 to get the full cashback.
Paid $329, cashback tracked quickly for $98.67
[ImTofu] I bought mine with Nostech Traders Pty Ltd only cuz it's 6c cheaper lol
arrived within a week
[sszjy] Do you got tax invoice from this store? is this grey import?
[ImTofu] Everyday market issued an invoice after the order is confirmed, with Everyday Market's and the company's ABN.
It is the same price at Officeworks and Kogan (through Apple), but you're here so you want the cashback…
[Simoneee] Hoselink 20m seems to be a deal after cashback
[Nathan1989] PSA for anyone using TopCashback AU — check your cashback before assuming it will be paid.
During last Everyday Market promotion, I purchased a pair of DDR5 memory and made sure my order met the promotion requirements and the retailer's conditions. The $150 cashback tracked successfully in my TopCashback account, so I assumed everything was fine and that it would eventually be confirmed.
However, about a month later, I checked my account and found that the entire $150 cashback had been cancelled, with TopCashback stating: “This cashback has been declined by the retailer.”
I had to submit a ticket with TopCashback to dispute the decline and now need to wait for another 3-4 months.
[Fake Account] I'm sure @tightarse will be helpful. Did you return/exchange any item?
[illusion99] lol all he ever says is that it’s with the merchant and the only thing they can do is wait
[Fake Account] At least he can tell you why it was declined in the first place?
[tightarse] lol all he ever says is that it’s with the merchant and the only thing they can do is wait
Really? When have I ever said that? No record of you ever reaching out to me.
[illusion99] @tightarse: Based on your previous responses to other people
[tightarse] @illusion99: Please link me the comments.
[tightarse] Hey @Nathan1989. I can assure you that Woolies don't decline tracked cashback for no reason. I'd take a bet that you applied a code at checkout, or used a gift card for purchase. Other reasons are partial refunds/exchanges etc, as they consider that a refund. Please ping me directly with your details and I'll look it up. Cheers!
[bub] Hey guys I made an order through the TCB app, how long does it usually take to track?
[bub] Ah man, mines still not tracked and it's been 5 hours.
[bub] @tightarse should I cancel my order if it hasn't tracked?
[Fake Account] @bub: Did you use any promo code at checkout, or used gift card/points for payment?
[bub] @Fake Account: Nah no promo codes, no gift cards. I clicked from the TCB app on everyday market, made sure my cart was empty before that, added the product, clicked on the cart, signed into my account, payed with Apple Pay, then closed the tab back into the TCB app.
[bub] @bub: It's a mattress so I can't really return it after the fact either haha!
[Fake Account] @bub: Also with an order value between $200 and $1000?
If you used the app and followed everything, maybe give it a bit more time?
Cancelling an order with everyday market is not easy. Last time I didn’t notice the $200 minimum spend and tried to cancel my order only minutes after placing it. Wasn’t successful.
[bub] @Fake Account: Yeah product was $249 and shipping 14.99, total 263.99 to Apple Pay. Hopefully tightarse can fix it 🙏
Thanks for your help @Fake Account

Like Temu, SB would approve within 6 weeks but TCB always took 3 months
